title: Flamingo holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloonGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9ecb'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ff4f8b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d81e63'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bodyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb3d1'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff7aa8'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M30 42 Q34 30 38 20' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='14' rx='11' ry='13' fill='url(#balloonGrad)'/>
  <polygon points='36,26 42,26 39,30' fill='#d81e63'/>
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='9' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#ffd1e4' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <line x1='52' y1='74' x2='51' y2='92' stroke='#ff5c93' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='74' x2='64' y2='92' stroke='#ff5c93' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='51' y1='92' x2='47' y2='94' stroke='#ff5c93' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='51' y1='92' x2='54' y2='95' stroke='#ff5c93' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='92' x2='61' y2='95' stroke='#ff5c93' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='92' x2='68' y2='94' stroke='#ff5c93' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='62' rx='19' ry='15' fill='url(#bodyGrad)' transform='rotate(-12 57 62)'/>

  <!-- wing -->
  <path d='M47 58 Q58 54 70 60 Q60 68 47 58 Z' fill='#ff9dbf' stroke='#ffd1e4' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M75 62 Q84 58 82 68 Q78 66 74 68 Z' fill='#ff4f8b'/>

  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M45 52 Q40 40 44 30 Q46 24 51 24' stroke='#ffb3d1' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='53' cy='22' r='8' fill='#ffb3d1'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='55' cy='20' r='2.2' fill='#fff4f8'/>
  <circle cx='55.4' cy='20' r='1.1' fill='#b0174f'/>

  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M60 24 Q68 25 66 30 Q62 31 59 28 Z' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <path d='M60 27 Q64 29 65 30 Q62 31 59 28 Z' fill='#7a3d00' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
